entries.title: Lead sources, offers, money and Voice AI
items: Lead source buttons for Mario's 7 sources: PPC, Mailers, M Software, Outbound, MLS, Referral and Drive By. Each one shows every number for that source.
Offer numbers: offers made, contract to offer and offer to contract.
Money cards: spend, cost per lead, cost per deal and ROAS. These need the passphrase.
Lead source scorecard and sales rep scorecard.
New Voice AI section: calls, talk time, callers who became leads, booked and transferred calls.
A booked appointment now counts as a contact, the same rule as Premier Builders.
The MLS offer is now counted under MLS instead of PPC.

entries.title: Dashboard launched
items: Sales KPIs from GoHighLevel, updated every hour, in the account's time zone.
Filter by date, lead source and sales rep, with a comparison to the previous period.
"How this works" guide and an ⓘ on every number.
Lead lists need the team passphrase. Show/hide the passphrase, and "Remember me" on your own device.
PJ and Mario are hidden from the sales rep views.
